notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.notes: [p]We are honored to announce that Vertex Zero will be present at the Tokyo Game Show 2025, alongside 12 other fantastic titles at the Red Dunes Games booth.[/p][p][/p][p]If you stop by, you'll have the opportunity to try our demo of Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World.[/p][p]You might even walk away with some exclusive goodies![/p][p]Our two co-founders will be on-site and available to hear your comments and answer any questions.[/p][p]We would love to see you there![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801669/bece723731ff30f9bf703db142c4f4115bfd7263.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Location: Makuhari Messe, Hall 7, Booth 07-N14[/p][p][/p][p]Business Days:[/p][p]Sep. 25 (Thu.) 10:00 - 17:00[/p][p]Sep. 26 (Fri.) 10:00 - 17:00[/p][p]Public Days:[/p][p]Sep. 27 (Sat.) 9:30 - 17:00[/p][p]Sep. 28 (Sun.) 9:30 - 16:30[/p][p][/p][p]Be among the first to test out Silent Planet! [/p]

notes.title: Publisher announcement
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce our partnership with Red Dunes Games.
We had the chance to answer a few questions on [url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/10/silent-planet-to-be-published-by-red.html]Netto's Game Room[/url] regarding updates on Silent Planet.

[url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/10/silent-planet-to-be-published-by-red.html][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801669/bd4ae3f3c9afc0944ab26a15f065f6bf51695158.png[/img][/url]

We also showcased our short teaser made especially for this occasion.
Thank you to everyone that participated in the video!

You can find the full interview [url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/10/silent-planet-to-be-published-by-red.html]here[/url].

notes.title: Interview with the Dev team
notes.notes:
A week ago, we had the pleasure of getting interviewed by Benjamin B from [url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/08/silent-planet-what-is-upcoming-space.html]Netto's Game Room[/url].
In this interview, we shed some light on a few of our gameplay elements, without giving everything away...

[url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/08/silent-planet-what-is-upcoming-space.html][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801669/d8bdb3e2a2e1d55bf2ae4d661e09501b8c6d9d59.png[/img][/url]

We also shared a few screenshots and animated GIFs to give you an idea of the overal aesthetics behind Silent Planet: a blend of cosmic horror, sci-fi and gothic.

Enjoy the read and don't hesitate to join our Discord if your questions remained unanswered in this [url=https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2024/08/silent-planet-what-is-upcoming-space.html]interview[/url]!
